metadata.baseline_note: proofs come from SEPOLIA_PROOFS, not from report_run: same circuit, root and nullifiers, recipients replaced by fresh wallets (the published recipients carry third-party EIP-7702 code on Sepolia that rejects ETH). verify_record gas depends on the calldata bytes, so it differs from report_run by a few tens of gas; a fresh recipient adds the cost of creating its account in settle.

round.note: withdrawals are sent one after another, each waiting for its receipt — round_wall_ms is the total time of this sequential round, not a throughput measurement
